items.title: Cross-Functional Decision Brief
items.intent: Convert ambiguous stakeholder input into a decision-ready brief with explicit tradeoffs and surfaced dissent.
items.author: Clinton Pracher

output_schema.decision: The single decision this brief supports
output_schema.options: 2-3 paths with tradeoffs and cost bearers
output_schema.dissent: Named disagreements and why each side is rational
output_schema.openQuestions: What must be true before committing

items.title: Launch Readiness Gate Review
items.intent: Run a pre-ship gate with explicit go, no-go, or defer criteria tied to product risk, not a generic checklist.
items.author: Clinton Pracher

output_schema.scopeSummary: What ships and blast radius if wrong
output_schema.riskScores: Product, technical, operational, support ratings with rationale
output_schema.openItems: Blocker vs mitigation vs accepted risk
output_schema.postLaunchWatch: Top signals and owners for first 48 hours

items.title: AI Product Governance Review
items.intent: Review an AI product change for ownership, audit path, trust boundaries, and rollback before it ships.
items.author: Clinton Pracher

output_schema.userPromise: What the user believes the feature does
output_schema.auditPath: How to reconstruct a session for review
output_schema.failureAndRollback: Top failures, signals, rollback steps, owners

items.title: Product Operating Model Review
items.intent: Stress-test or propose changes to product forums, decision rights, and escalation paths without org-chart theater.
items.author: Clinton Pracher

output_schema.currentState: Forums mapped to decision types and crack decisions
output_schema.failureModes: Symptoms tied to missing owners or forums
output_schema.proposedModel: Product vs program ownership and decision rights
output_schema.forumDesign: What each forum decides and cadence

items.title: Data Product Readiness Review
items.intent: Evaluate whether a metric layer, reporting product, or data initiative is decision-ready for leadership use.
items.author: Clinton Pracher

output_schema.decisionTest: The leadership decision this product must support
output_schema.definitionAudit: Metrics with owner, logic, and source of truth
output_schema.lineageConfidence: What leadership needs to trust the output
output_schema.stakeholderReadiness: Adopted vs parallel definitions by stakeholder group

items.title: Portfolio Investment Prioritization Brief
items.intent: Rank portfolio initiatives against shared capacity, budget, and strategic constraints with explicit tradeoffs.
items.author: Clinton Pracher

output_schema.investmentFrame: What capacity and budget must protect or unlock this quarter
output_schema.rankedInitiatives: Ordered list with capacity cost, owner, and deferral risk
output_schema.deprioritized: What drops and who accepts the cost
output_schema.recommendation: Funded set, deferred set, and alignment sentence
